digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI/CD workflows
propositions: External integration tests run against only one live provider (Anthropic) despite supporting multiple providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetected by CI

Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm obtaining credentials for its respective provider and skipping loudly when credentials are absent

Bedrock authentication on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials rather than EC2 instance roles, with explicit AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION environment variables

Provider selection must use REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a config file setting only [llm.model_classes] to align CI with documented local developer workflow and ensure the override mechanism receives live test coverage
The ambient cfg.model default was hardcoded to Anthropic and must be provider-qualified per arm overlay to prevent tests from silently falling back to the default provider on non-Anthropic arms
